title: Focused SoundTouch rerun contaminated by stale bridge execution DLL path
layer: bridge execution metadata for local analyze-path DLLs
symptom: Focused rerun 01367970 executed SoundTouch tools against C:\mcp-factory\uploads\SoundTouchDLL_x64.dll after that staged file no longer existed, producing FileNotFoundError results that looked like semantic failures.
smallest_reproducer: Analyze-path a local SoundTouch DLL through the 8201 -> 8090 lane, then run a focused explore after the legacy upload-path copy disappears; invocable execution.dll_path still points at the vanished upload filename.
trust_impact: Focused findings for setters and sample-buffer functions become untrustworthy because bridge load-path errors masquerade as DLL semantic failures.
allowed_next_actions: use a stable existing runtime DLL copy for focused reruns
inspect bridge-side upload path persistence and execution.dll_path refresh logic
add a durable content-addressed execution path for local analyze-path DLLs
disallowed_next_actions: treat FileNotFoundError-focused runs as semantic evidence
spend more broad SoundTouch reruns on the contaminated job
rank architectural systems based on the stale-path run
exit_criteria: focused reruns execute against a stable on-disk DLL path that still exists during probe execution
bridge breadcrumbs stop reporting FileNotFoundError for the staged SoundTouch path
targeted SoundTouch conclusions are based on semantic outcomes instead of loader failures
